notes.title: Grant Update
notes.content:
[h3]DIFFICULTY BALANCING[/h3]
Shrot is now easier on the easy difficulty. Difficulty can be changed at any time in Options, but may not be reflected in older saved games where previously planned attacks are already in progress. 
However, it is still necessary to keep in mind that numerous losses on all sides and constant pressure from enemies are a fundamental feature of the game and victory is never free. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893472/19f0641f87ccef6ed21dfee36a4dc2bc3a67da5a.png[/img]

[h3]TUTORIAL AND ONBOARDING[/h3]
Tutorial in the first mission and the Economic Training are now improved and more understandable. I also added a button to display information about the selected unit/building, which was previously buried in the [b]Knowledge[/b] section. This section can also be opened with the [b]"I" key[/b] and contains information about all buildings and units.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893472/a7643f8877d309e6ba3544df0db242635aa57ce2.png[/img]

[h3]KEYSTROKE HELP[/h3]
The game can be controlled entirely with the mouse and there is no need to touch the keyboard, but some keys are very useful:

[h3]Selection[/h3]
[b]Shift+Click[/b] - Add or remove unit from current selection
[b]Double Click[/b] - Select all units of the same type on the screen
[b]Ctrl+0-9[/b] - Assign selected units (or buildings) to group
[b]Shift+0-9[/b] - Add selected units to the group
[b]0-9[/b] - Select units in the group
[b]Double 0-9[/b] - Select units in the group and pan to them
[b]Q[/b] - Select idle Tractors/Harvesters
[b]W[/b] - Select all combat units
[b]I[/b] - Knowledge about selected unit/building

[h3]Units[/h3]
[b]Mouse wheel[/b] - Click in production to max queue
[b]M[/b] - Move
[b]A[/b] - Attack (and Attack Move)
[b]S[/b] - Stop (Defend Area)
[b]H[/b] - Stop (Hold Position)

[h3]Camera[/h3]
[b]Arrow keys[/b] - Move camera
[b]Mouse wheel[/b] - Adjust view height, hold to drag camera
[b]F[/b] - Follow the selected unit
[b]Ctrl+F2-F4[/b] - Save location
[b]F2-F4[/b] - Go to saved location
[b]Spacebar[/b] - View the area of the last warning
[b]Home[/b] - View the base
[b]+/-[/b] - UI Scale

[h3]Buildings[/h3]
[b]R[/b] - Toggle Repair Mode
[b]X[/b] - Toggle Shutdown Mode
[b]C[/b] - Toggle Sell Mode

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893472/9300e995c46d99c7a3f4e13095d5104540d3189b.png[/img]

[h3]FULL V1.4 CHANGELOG[/h3]
[list]
[*] Difficulty Balancing
[*] Reworked tutorial and onboarding (mission 1 and economy training)
[*] Reworked console messages (only one message is displayed)
[*] New hotkey "I" to show knowledge about the selected unit/building (new button in the sidebar can also be used)
[*] Fix: woman's voice sometimes stopped working
[*] Fix: laugh when AI capturing units 
[*] Fix: "We are under attack" voice in the German version
[/list]

[i]Thank You!
Spytihněv[/i]

notes.title: Shrot is out now!
notes.content:
As the title suggests, Shrot is OUT NOW!
This time, the launch was a bit more modest. Due to poor wishlist numbers, some cuts had to be made. So, no party at the Factory Club, no sandwiches, and no chocolate fountain. Even the accompanying cultural program, including the magician, has been canceled. I'll just order pizza and that's it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2630920/Shrot/

[h2]Acknowledgments[/h2]
[list]
[*] I would like to thank the musicians [b][url=https://www.facebook.com/GinkgoLanugo/]Ginko Lanugo[/url][/b] (Štěpán and Nikola) for the soundtrack and cooperation. The soundtrack can also be purchased on their [url=https://ginkgolanugo.bandcamp.com/]Bandcamp[/url]. It should already be available on Spotify and Youtube.

[*] The nice voice that speaks in Czech and English when a unit is ready or an enemy is attacking is [b]Viktorie's[/b]. You can follow her on [url=https://www.instagram.com/viktoriesurma/]Instagram[/url].

[*] And of course, thanks to [b]Phoenix Arts[/b] for Paranoia. It was an honor to reference it in Shrot nearly 30 years later.

[*] Others are listed in the end credits after completing the game.
[/list]

[h2]Future Work[/h2]
If Shrot happens to attract a wider audience than a few veterans, an expansion will be a possibility. We would need to sell at least one copy of the game in Mongolia though. Otherwise, work will begin on a new project in September (not sure what it will be yet, but there are plenty of ideas, and I'll decide over the summer). I'll keep you [url=https://x.com/kotolout]updated on 𝕏[/url].
Finally, I'd like to mention our [url=https://discord.gg/vKsNHVqKx6]Discord[/url] server, which is primarily about Hrot, but Shrot has its own little section there too.

[h3]And now, all that's left is to wish you enjoy Shrot. If you do, I'll be grateful for a review![/h3]

With sincerest regards,
Spytihněv

notes.title: Shrot Release Date
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Shrot will be released [b]on Thursday, June 20th[/b]. ːsteamsadː Steam says 7pm CEST, but it's more likely to be a random time of day depending on my mood.

[previewyoutube=VjhDNVBRqR8;full][/previewyoutube]

The demo will be available as part of #SteamFest until Monday, June 17th, then it will be burned. Saved games from the demo will also work in the full game, so you can continue where you left off or start from the beginning thanks to good replayability.

If you don't have it yet, give a [b]wishlist[/b] and a [b]follow[/b] so that you don't miss the release.

All that's left is to wish you a nice weekend,

Spytihněv
